resources.string: Make attendance part of your routine
One place. Your weekly schedule. Your records, saved on this phone.
A fresh location reading registers your place. Later checks verify that you are nearby; raw check coordinates are discarded.
Allow precise location to register your place.
Turn on location services, then try again.
The location request timed out. Try again outdoors.
Your location is unavailable. Try again.
That location reading is too old. Request a fresh one.
A more accurate location is needed. Try again outdoors.
Could not save on this phone. Your form is still here; try again.
Enter your name, register a place, and check the schedule and whole-day balance.
Whole days only. Holidays and weekly days off do not use this balance.
Google Sheets is optional. You can connect later in Settings.
Open Daymark to verify your location and record today’s attendance.
Reminders are allowed. Daymark plans the next 30 calendar days when you return.
Reminders are unavailable. You can still check in manually.
Your attendance stays on this phone.
Your local records could not be opened. Retry without deleting anything.
You are outside your registered place. Attendance has not been confirmed.
Allow precise location to check your attendance.
Your day or plan changed. Review the current record and try again.
Could not read your local records. Reopen this screen to try again.
Scheduled tracking has not started. You can still check in manually today.
Choose the status explicitly. A time is required for Present or Late. This does not verify a past location.
Choose Present, Late, or Absent, and provide an arrival time when needed. This date must be a tracked attendance day without time off.
Attendance corrections cannot replace a day off, holiday, or vacation. Manage its dates in Plan.
The attendance window has not started.
Check the selected days, times, radius and available balance.
Your records changed. Review a fresh preview before saving.
There are not enough vacation days for this change.
Schedule changes start on %1$s. Today and past records keep their saved plan.
Balance change · %1$s days. Available after · %2$s days.

One best-effort check at arrival. Android may delay or block it. Precise foreground and background location are required. An unconfirmed day becomes Absent after the grace period; you can check manually later.
Automatic checking stays off until the required location permissions and services are available. Manual attendance is still available.
On iPhone, check-in is user initiated. Reminders and the home-screen button open a fresh location check.
Reminders cover the next 30 calendar days. Reopen Daymark to refresh them.
Some scheduled checks, reminders, or widget updates need attention. Your records are saved on this phone.
Records save on this phone first. Sheets is an outgoing report; edits in Sheets are not imported and may be replaced.
Google is not connected. Local tracking works normally.
Report connected · upload status shown below
The report structure changed. Rebuild its managed sections or create a new report.
The report is unavailable. Reconnect or create a new report.
Upload acknowledged. Sheets was checked during this session.
Connected · saved local changes will sync automatically
Report creation is uncertain. Connect again to search for it. A new report will not be created automatically.
More than one report was found. Choose the report to use.
Google connection was cancelled. Your local records are kept.
Could not connect. Your local records are kept. Try again when Google is available.
Deletion did not finish. Check your retained local records before trying again. Automation and Google uploads are paused.
Delete this phone’s profile, attendance, time off, settings and widget data? Scheduled work stops. Existing Google reports stay in Drive. This cannot be undone; Sheets is not a restore backup.
Replace edits in this report’s managed headers and attendance rows with this phone’s records? Unrelated tabs and existing reports are kept.
Create another Google report from this phone’s records? Existing reports remain in Drive.
Stop uploads and forget the Google session on this phone? Local records and existing Google reports are kept.
Keep the note within %1$s characters before saving.
Some fields are too long for Google Sheets. Other records can still sync. Shorten the named field in the app.
%1$s · %2$s: too long to upload. Your full text is kept on this phone.
✓ Present · ! Late · × Absent · — Day off · ○ Planned · · Not tracked
Saved on this phone · Google is not connected
Saved locally · Google report needs attention in Settings
Planned date. Attendance has not been recorded yet.

Track your own attendance at work, school, or a course. Your records stay on this phone and work offline. Google reporting is optional. Location is requested only when you choose to register your place or check attendance.
Changes have not been saved yet
Discard the unreadable setup draft and start again? Your language and appearance preferences will be kept.
Start tracking now, or finish and customize optional permissions, Google reporting, and widgets in Settings. You can return to these options at any time.

Add Daymark from your phone’s home screen widget picker. On Android, touch and hold an empty area and choose Widgets. On iPhone, edit the home screen and choose Add Widget. Tap the widget to open Daymark and check attendance with a fresh location reading; the widget itself never confirms attendance.
